title: Hitchhiker effect at Thomas Winterton's home

tellings.quote: Thomas has had things happen in his home upon returning from Skinwalker Ranch.

plain: Strange things are said to have happened in the home of a man named Thomas Winterton after he came back from Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events. This is the "hitchhiker effect", the idea that whatever goes on at the ranch can follow people home. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells Michels this as something Winterton told him, without describing the events themselves.
